title: Telecommunications and Media Industries, B.A. (Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications)
notes: Built from the archived 2024-25 bulletin (raw HTML fetched directly, cross-checked against printed subtotals: 15/16/16-17/15/15/15/15/13, Total Credits 120-121). This is a genuinely distinct, transitional catalog year -- neither TELE-2022/2023.json's old plan nor TELE-2026.json's current one, confirmed by fetching this year's own Suggested Academic Plan table rather than assuming it matched either neighbor. What changed vs. 2023: the university's Gen Ed reform fully landed in the plan table itself this year (2023's plan table still printed the old domain layout despite a same-page 'Spring 2024' prose update -- see TELE-2023.json's notes) -- Semester 3/4 now show 'General Education Course (Exploration)' and '(Inter-Domain)' slots, 'BA World Cultures'/'BA Knowledge Domain', and 'World Language' (renamed from 'Foreign Language') Level 1-3, matching 2026's Gen Ed vocabulary. A standalone 'Social Aspects of Communication Course' requirement first appears as its own labeled plan row this year, in Semester 2 (it later moved to Semester 3 in 2025-26 and was folded into a combined 'Social Aspects...or Professional Course' choice for 2026-27 -- three different real positions across three real years, not a transcription drift). PSU 9 sits in Semester 1 this year (not Semester 2, where 2025/2026 place it) -- a real difference confirmed by this year's own printed Fall/Spring subtotals (15/16), which only balance with PSU 9 in the Fall column. What DIDN'T change vs. 2023: the ECON 102/ECON 14/SCM 200/STAT 200 choice (Semester 3) and a 3-credit 'Law Course' requirement (COMM 403/403H/404/492, Semester 6) both survived from the old model and were not dropped until 2025-26 -- this year's Requirements-for-the-Major course-list text (Prescribed Courses still just COMM 160/180/280/380; no COMM 205 or COMM 404-as-prescribed yet) is otherwise identical to 2023's own Additional/Supporting pools (Additional = COMM 170/190(GAME 140)/282/283/310(IST)/374/383/384/385/386/388/479/482/483/484/484A/491/491A/493/495; Social Aspects = COMM 110/118/205(WMNST)/304/305/405/409/410/412/413W/417/418/419/419H/496) -- confirmed by direct text comparison, not assumed. This is the exact 'Suggested-Plan-vs-Requirements drift' pattern documented in TELE-2026.json's own notes and docs/BRANCH_CAMPUS_FINDINGS.md's methodology: the plan table already uses the new Gen Ed layout while the accompanying prose course-list still describes the old select-12/select-3-law/select-3-capstone structure verbatim, so the 3 generic 'Professional Course' plan-row slots (Semesters 5, 6, 7) are wired here to that same old Additional-Courses pool rather than fabricated. The Semester-4 'General Education Course (GQ)' item carries this year's own printed conditional footnote ('if ECON 102 is taken 3rd semester, OR GS if STAT 200 is taken 3rd semester') and Semester-8 carries the matching conditional 1cr elective, both left as generic slots (no cross-semester conditional mechanism in the engine, same caveat as 2022/2023). 'End Campus: University Park' confirmed on this archive's own page, unchanged from every other year checked -- no campus field needed. 'etm' marks Entrance-to-Major requirement courses.
